inline.headline: Reseal or a leak? Find out first.
inline.text: Photograph the shower in Jib and it tells you whether it's a simple reseal or a waterproofing job, with the steps and the shopping list saved.
inline.alt: Old mouldy silicone cut out of the corner of a shower recess in one long strip, lying on the tiles next to a scraper blade and a roll of blue painter's tape

jobs.title: Reseal the shower
jobs.description: Silicone is black in the corners and peeling at the base. Tiles are solid.
directions: Cut out all the old silicone
Soften the rest with remover, scrape, wipe with metho
Kill the mould and let it dry overnight
Tape both sides, run one bead, smooth it
Pull the tape, keep water off until cured

end.headline: A shower you don't scrub around.
end.alt: A mum and her young daughter brushing their teeth together at the vanity, a bright clean shower with fresh white silicone behind them

jobs.title: Get the shower leak checked
jobs.description: Skirting in the hallway is swelling and the paint is bubbling. New silicone didn't stop it.
directions: Photograph the damp wall and skirting
Note when it gets worse after showers
Book a licensed waterproofer
Send the brief with your photos

inline.headline: The smell won't come back.
inline.text: Add the drum clean to Jib as a monthly job and the pump filter every two months. Jib reminds you, with the steps for your machine saved.
inline.alt: The small flap at the bottom of a front loader open with the pump filter cap unscrewed, a shallow baking tray on a folded towel in front of it catching the water, a few coins in the tray

jobs.title: Run the washing machine drum clean
jobs.description: Empty drum, Drum Clean cycle with cleaner. Wipe the door seal after.
directions: Empty the drum and check for socks
Add cleaner as the manual says
Run Drum Clean or the hottest cycle
Wipe the seal dry, leave the door ajar

jobs.title: Clean the washing machine pump filter

end.headline: Fresh washing, every load.
end.alt: A dad and his son pegging fresh washing on a backyard clothesline on a sunny afternoon, a laundry basket at their feet

jobs.title: Fix the washing machine that won't drain
jobs.description: Filter's clean but water still sits in the drum. Impeller feels stuck.
directions: Turn it off at the wall
Note the model number inside the door
Book a qualified repairer
Send the brief with your photos

inline.headline: Clean panels, both feet on the grass.
inline.text: Add a quick solar check to Jib, done from the ground, and set the licensed service to repeat every two years. Jib reminds you when each one's due.
inline.alt: A mum standing in the backyard of a single-storey house in early morning light, gently brushing dust off the solar panels with a soft brush on a long extension pole

jobs.title: Hose the solar panels from the ground
jobs.description: Dusty after a dry spell. Single storey, panels reachable from the lawn.
directions: Check for cracks from the ground first
Go early, while the panels are cool
Gentle hose spray, no pressure washer
Soft brush only, stay off the roof

end.headline: Sunshine in. Nobody on the roof.
end.alt: A family having a picnic lunch on the back lawn on a sunny day, the solar panels on their single-storey roof behind them

jobs.title: Get the solar panels cleaned
jobs.description: Two storey, can't reach from the ground. Bird droppings on the top row.
directions: Photograph the panels from the ground
Note the panel brand for the warranty
Book a cleaner with fall protection
Check output on the app afterwards
